categories.main_business_segments: MasTec operates through five primary business segments: Communications, Clean Energy and Infrastructure, Power Delivery, Oil and Gas, and Other. Each segment focuses on a distinct set of infrastructure construction and maintenance services, serving a range of end markets including telecommunications, renewable energy, utilities, heavy civil, and industrial infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in engineering, building, installation, maintenance, and upgrade of infrastructure using advanced construction management, project engineering, and field deployment methods. MasTec leverages technologies such as fiber optics, wireless and wireline communications, renewable energy systems (wind, solar, battery storage), smart grid solutions, and pipeline integrity management, with a focus on safety, environmental compliance, and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: MasTec's primary customers are large providers in the communications, utility, power (including renewable energy), civil, and transportation infrastructure sectors. The company serves telecommunications carriers, utilities, energy companies, government agencies, and industrial clients, often under multi-year master service agreements or project-specific contracts.
categories.geographic_coverage: MasTec operates mainly in North America, with a strong presence across the United States and Canada. The company has approximately 850 locations and 34,000 employees as of year-end 2023, and also undertakes select international projects through its 'Other' segment.
categories.supply_chain_position: MasTec is positioned as a downstream service provider, focusing on the construction, installation, and maintenance of infrastructure for end customers. The company does not manufacture materials or equipment but provides labor-based, technical, and project management services at the point of infrastructure deployment and operation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, MasTec is focused on growth in clean energy, grid modernization, telecommunications (especially 5G and fiber), and infrastructure resilience. The company invests in expanding its capabilities through acquisitions, integration of new technologies, and sustainability initiatives, with an emphasis on supporting the transition to low-carbon energy and digital connectivity.
categories.revenue_model: MasTec generates revenue primarily through project-based contracts and multi-year master service agreements, billing customers for engineering, construction, installation, maintenance, and upgrade services. Revenue is recognized over time using a cost-to-cost method, with a mix of fixed price, unit price, and time-and-materials contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: MasTec competes with large national firms such as Quanta Services, MYR Group, Dycom Industries, Jacobs Solutions, and Primoris Services, as well as numerous regional and local contractors. The company is one of the largest infrastructure construction firms in North America, with a reputation for technical expertise, reliability, and broad service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, MasTec reported $12.0 billion in revenue, up 23% from $9.8 billion in 2022, reflecting both organic growth and acquisitions. The company has a large workforce and significant backlog ($12.4 billion as of year-end 2023), but reported a net loss of $47 million in 2023 due to acquisition and integration costs, higher interest expense, and inflationary pressures. Adjusted EBITDA was $860 million (7.2% margin), indicating strong operational scale but recent margin compression.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MasTec differentiates itself through its comprehensive, end-to-end infrastructure solutions, technical expertise, and ability to execute large, complex projects across multiple industries. The company emphasizes its North American scale, diversified customer base, rapid response capabilities, and commitment to safety, sustainability, and innovation in supporting the energy transition and digital transformation.
